text.description_html:
First Impressions ATC150ACHSBRSEC, Clearwater Hand Chiseled 1-1/2" Acrylic Door Handle with Sigma Brackets

The Sigma Mounts add a modern feel to this hand chiseled acrylic door pull. The Clearwater Hand Chiseled 1-1/2 inch Diameter Acrylic Door Handle gives the illusion of cascading water, making this a great addition to contemporary bathrooms as a shower door pull or on an executive office building that has a water feature in the front. The Modern Clearwater Acrylic Door Pull can be thru-bolt mounted, surface mounted, or back-to-back mounted on wood, glass, fiberglass, or metal doors. Choose from 18 inch, 24 inch, 36 inch, or 48 inch lengths.

Specifications for the First Impressions ATC150ACHSBRSEC Acrylic Door Pull:

  • Pull Handle Material: Hand Chiseled Clear Acrylic
  • Mount Material: Brass
  • First Impressions ATC150ACHSBRSEC Dimensional Diagram (PDF)

Available in 3 Sizes:

    ATC150018ACHSBRSEC:
    • Total Length: 18"
    • Center to Center Mount: 12"
    • Pull Handle Diameter: 1-1/2"
    • Total Projection: 3.19"

    ATC150024ACHSBRSEC:
    • Total Length: 24"
    • Center to Center Mount: 18"
    • Pull Handle Diameter: 1-1/2"
    • Total Projection: 3.19"

    ATC150036ACHSBRSEC:
    • Total Length: 36"
    • Center to Center Mount: 24"
    • Pull Handle Diameter: 1-1/2"
    • Total Projection: 3.19"

    ATC150048ACHSBRSEC:
    • Total Length: 48"
    • Center to Center Mount: 36"
    • Pull Handle Diameter: 1-1/2"
    • Total Projection: 3.19"

Note: This door handle is handmade in the USA when you order it— it can be custom designed to fit your specific door application. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

When Selecting a Mounting Hardware:

  • Thru-Bolted Mounting: Pull bolts through the door.
  • Surface Mounting: Pull screws to the face of the door.
  • Back-to-Back Mounting: Pulls bolt to each other through the door. Requires 2 pulls.

Sold individually (1 door pull handle). If you order Back-to-Back Mounting please Order 2 Pulls.
